bio: This urban inn, sporting a bistro vibe and fronted by a delicatessen, is blessed with a quaint, old-fashioned name! It is also a family story that unites three veterans who’ve knocked around a bit. Each dish bears the chef’s distinctive hallmark (special mention for the side dishes and the starters, to share). The accent is on classic Gallic nosh with a modern twist in terms of presentation; the menu is more elaborate in the evening....
